subject: Faceless cusk eel
topic: This fish looks like it has no face.
script:
This fish looks like it has no face.
It's called the faceless cusk eel.
It has no visible eyes, and its mouth is tucked away underneath its head.
Instead of eyes, it finds its way using two pairs of large nostrils on its snout.
Its scientific name means a blind hake with a large nose.
And despite its name, it isn't a true eel at all.
The first one was hauled up by a British expedition in the eighteen seventies.
Then it was barely seen again for more than a century.
This one was filmed by a NOAA robot near the Cook Islands, in twenty twenty-six.
How would you find your way without eyes?
